Subject: Vendor onboarding: billing entity + PO routing questions

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're ready to move Redwood through our marketplace onboarding pipeline but need to confirm a couple of procurement items before we start the listing paperwork:

- Billing entity: our procurement team needs to confirm whether Redwood will be paid by Acme Retail US (w/ W-9) or through our UK subsidiary (requires VAT paperwork). Can you confirm your invoicing entity and whether you accept a US-payor PO?
- PO routing: Acme prefers Net30 POs routed to marketplace-payables@acme-retail.com. For marketplace purchases via AWS Marketplace/Azure Marketplace/GCP Marketplace we sometimes need the vendor to accept marketplace billing vs direct PO. Will Redwood accept marketplace-mediated billing for AWS and Azure?
- Escrow/contract: our legal team flagged potential escrow/indemnity language for marketplace listings — is that standard for Redwood or negotiable?

I've attached our standard Vendor Intake Form (Vendor_Intake_Form.xlsx) and the requested fields are highlighted on tab "Billing".

Next steps from our side: once we confirm billing entity + PO path we can share the marketplace listing checklist and the vendor agreement. Can you loop in whoever owns billing/finance on your side?

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: billing entity + PO routing questions

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the form and the clear asks. Quick answers up front, and then a proposed next step: 

1) Billing entity: Redwood can invoice Acme Retail US (Redwood Inference, Inc.). We can provide a W-9 for US-based payors. If you require VAT paperwork for a UK entity we can provision a UK billing entity, but that typically adds a ~2 week setup.

2) Marketplace billing: We support both marketplace-mediated billing and direct PO depending on the channel. For AWS Marketplace we usually go marketplace-billing unless the customer requests a private contract. For Azure and GCP we support marketplace listings and direct PO paths — the choice impacts how invoices appear in your systems and whether we receive a marketplace-managed payout.

3) Escrow/contract: Redwood's standard listing terms do not include escrow. We are open to limited indemnity adjustments for enterprise agreements, but escrow arrangements are evaluated case-by-case and would require legal review.

I've attached our Redwood Vendor Packet (Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf) with our W-9 and sample PO instructions. To keep this moving, can we do a 30-minute call Monday to confirm the billing entity and whether Acme wants marketplace-mediated billing for AWS specifically? If so, Vanessa can confirm finance-level PO routing and Lauren can kick off listing intake.

Proposed: Mon Jul 27 10:00 AM PT — I'll send a calendar invite if that works.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
